itemized.escalation_note: Both itemized pages are LANDSCAPE attachments. A two-up probe render (both rotation signs side by side at reduced size) established that rotate(+90) CCW is correct for THIS file, then p4 and p6 were re-rendered at 200 dpi, rotated CCW and cropped tight to the table for the transcription read.
